description: Analyze a local SQLite database for performance problems and recommend fixes: foreign keys with no index, redundant indexes, and full table scans for any supplied queries. Returns findings with runnable CREATE/DROP INDEX suggestions. Read-only — recommends, never alters the schema. (Local files only.)

queries.description: Optional SQL queries to check for full table scans

source.description: Local SQLite file path (advise requires direct file access)

name: litescope_advise

findings.description: Issues with rule, severity, and a runnable suggestion.

title: Recommend indexes
